headline_metric: F1 score (precision/recall of correct key presses) on ROBOPIANIST-ETUDE-12
human_data: PIG dataset (fingering labels) + REPERTOIRE-150 MIDI corpus
paper_code_mismatch: the code's CompositeReward sums 5 terms by default (key_press, sustain, energy, fingering, forearm) vs the paper's Table 2 documenting only 3 (Key Press, Energy Penalty, Finger Close to Key); sustain_reward and forearm_reward exist in code but are undocumented in the paper
note_gaps: exact Shadow Hand per-hand DoF count is never stated (only the combined 45-dim action space); domain-randomisation ranges (augmentations/randomize_hand_positions) are not detailed; CompositeReward.compute's internal weighting logic is not captured in code md, only its signature
